profile.headline: Senior Product Designer | Senior Frontend Developer | AVP at Wells Fargo

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
•	Devised various custom responsive WordPress sites from design comps that included advanced WordPress features, such as Custom Post Types, Advanced Custom Fields, and WordPress Customize API.
•	Provide adequate training to staff members as well as junior web developers in internal web functions, including steps on how to make minor updates/changes independently. 
•	Design and establish user-friendly websites, including optimized landing pages, resulting in improved user interaction.
•	Proactively liaised with design team and project manager to ensure efficient and timely delivery of significant projects.
•	Establish an interactive and dynamic website that guarantees high traffic, page views, and maximum user experience, generating an increase in company’s sales revenue.

positions.title: Junior Web Developer
positions.description:
•	Designed and developed responsive web applications across various platforms.
•	Worked closely with management, design team and digital team through the complete development cycle.
•	Developed and managed project plans while providing status updates to management.
•	Collaborated with SEO manager to implement technical, on-site and offsite SEO best practices. 
•	Serve as secondary support/administrator for core web platforms including web servers, CMS, web databases, Shopify, and WordPress.

positions.title: Web Developer Search Engine Optimization Intern
Stock Supervisor
positions.description:
•	Assists management with transfers, promotions, and unification of work to insure their accuracy. 
•	Designate tasks, review work, and provide detailed direction to coworkers guaranteeing that processes are met in established timelines.
•	Assist management with loss prevention efforts, while providing proactive customer service.
•	Professionally identifies areas of improvement and establish innovative work procedures. 
•	Ensure proper systems are accurate to support management team with inventory.
•	Assist with inventory preparations and practices.
•	Ensure that store operations are correct and provide detailed information for company audits.
